### Data Science {.about-title .glyph-chart-dots}

I study human behavior in transportation systems using discrete choice models and scenario simulation, focusing on smart charging [adoption](/research/2024-sc-adoption) and [economy](/research/2025-smc-economy) to generate policy suggestions for policymakers and utilities.

### Open-Source Software {.about-title .glyph-package}

I develop open-source {{< var rnolink >}} tools for survey research, including [surveydown](/research/2024-surveydown), a programmable, markdown-based survey platform built on Quarto, Shiny, and PostgreSQL, and its companion GUI [sdstudio](/research/2025-sdstudio).

### Agentic AI Engineering {.about-title .glyph-sparkles}

I build software with agentic workflows around Claude Code: plugins, skills, MCPs, and hooks. I write [tutorials](/blog/2026-03-26-agentic-engineering-1) and share my own [workflows](/blog/2026-05-15-agentic-workflows) on the blog, and run a [workshop](https://pingfan-hu.github.io/2026-agentic-workshop/) at [GW TAI](https://trustworthyai.gwu.edu) for researchers and developers. At [Alkaline Software](https://github.com/alkaline-software), we build desktop apps in Rust with [GPUI](https://www.gpui.rs) using the same workflows, including [Emaki](https://emaki.lol), our Agentic Development Environment.
